description: Arithmetic on quotes you already have; it looks nothing up. cash (default) totals flight, stay and extra costs per traveler. The other modes (awards, award_options, journeys, earning_plan, split_transfers) each take one object: call once with describe_mode=true to get that mode's input schema and rules. Nothing is ranked unless you pass the traveler's explicit objective. Long lists come as tables that the reply's tables field explains.

award_comparison.description: awards mode only. Get its shape with mode=awards, describe_mode=true.

award_options.description: award_options mode only. Get its shape with mode=award_options, describe_mode=true.

currency.description: cash mode: shared ISO currency code (e.g. USD).

describe_mode.description: true returns the input schema and rules for `mode` and compares nothing. Do this once before first using a mode other than cash.

earning_plan.description: earning_plan mode only. Get its shape with mode=earning_plan, describe_mode=true.

journey_comparison.description: journeys mode only. Get its shape with mode=journeys, describe_mode=true.

max_per_person.description: cash mode: optional max cash per traveler.

objective.description: cash mode only. Omit to keep input order.

options.description: cash mode: two or more sourced option bundles.

flight_total.description: Total for every covered passenger, not one fare

source.description: Short source label, at most 300 characters. Keep long booking URLs in the assistant response, not this field.

stay_total.description: Total for all rooms and nights, not a nightly price

split_transfers.description: split_transfers mode only. Get its shape with mode=split_transfers, describe_mode=true.

traveler_count.description: cash mode: travelers covered by options.

name: compare_quotes
title: Compare travel options and payment choices
